findings.issue: Reuters headline n1196 says only that inflation is widespread; text added a services/rent/wage shift not in the headline.
findings.resolution: Replaced with a neutral 'broad-based pressure that policy has to lean against'.

findings.issue: Colon after the Reuters explainer cite attributed our mortgage/financial-conditions reasoning to Reuters.
findings.resolution: Recast as our own reasoning ('because when the short end leads...').

findings.issue: Bloomberg 'lying flat' explainer was said to show a ceiling on mass consumption; headline does not say that.
findings.resolution: Softened to 'adds a social dimension to that restraint'.

findings.location: geo/CN Property and New/Most Important; anticipatory/3
findings.issue: Escrow-fund access is a Reuters 'report' headline; text presented it as done and as the most practical step; anticipatory/3 cited escrow only to the Evergrande headline n0235.
findings.resolution: Hedged ('if confirmed', 'per the Reuters report', 'may be reaching'); added n0245 to anticipatory/3 (second use of that ID).

findings.issue: Apple tap-to-pay headline cannot support a 'payments revenue line'.
findings.resolution: Rewritten to say it extends the iPhone base into payments with revenue unquantified.

findings.issue: Kansas City Fed headline is a question; the 'asset yields reprice faster than deposits' mechanism was presented as its content.
Realtor.com supply-gap headline does not state landlord occupancy/pricing outcome.
Stray ', By contrast' mid-sentence; causal 'because' for Uber's fall exceeded the Guardian headline.
Cameco restart 'signals confidence' stated as fact; 'aluminium is tighter' than copper conflicts with copper stocks at three days' consumption (n1936).
findings.resolution: Hedged to 'suggests'/'normally'; changed to 'just as tight'.

findings.issue: 'Growth managers are cutting' generalised from one fund (Cathie Wood headline).
findings.resolution: Reworded to 'Growth exposure is being cut'.

findings.issue: Facebook $230bn plunge (n0305) occurred 3 Feb US session, about 7 days before cutoff; borderline for news window.
findings.resolution: Left: it is the market reaction to Meta's 2 Feb results (company results window 14 days) and the stamp is 4 Feb; no new facts added.
